correctness.rationale: For every \(a>0,\ \varepsilon>0,\ \alpha>0,\ \beta\in[0,1)\), the dimensionless map \(F(z,w)=(z-cg(s),s),\ s=\beta w+(1-\beta)z,\ g(s)=s/\sqrt{1+s^2}\) has unique origin equilibrium. Its Jacobian has determinant \(\beta\) and trace \(1+\beta-d(1-\beta)\), \(d=c(1+s^2)^{-3/2}\). The exact Schur inequalities yield \(c_*=2(1+\beta)/(1-\beta)\). For any nontrivial two-cycle, momentum balance gives \(w_1=m-tD,\ w_2=m+tD\); odd injectivity forces \(m=0\), and \(2=ct/\sqrt{1+t^2D^2}\) yields the unique orbit iff \(c>c_*\). At that cycle \(d=8/(c^2t^3)<c_*\), so its monodromy is strictly Schur stable. At \(c=c_*\), the diagonalized coordinates \((u,v)\) have \(u^+=-u+tu^3+O(u^4)\) on a local center manifold, \(t>0\); hence \(u_n^{-2}/n\to2t\) and local asymptotic stability follows. Symbolic algebra checked the exact Jacobian conjugacy; bundled verify.py passed all 63 parameter configurations, 3000 numerical derivative comparisons, and four 40000-step critical tests. No finite check is used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Compared mathematical implications rather than titles: the motivating paper defines the map and gives small-step convergence, the Hamiltonian-Muon paper proves conditional small-step convergence for a regularized map, the quadratic Muon paper concerns signed/approximate polynomial projection, and nonlinear-preconditioned methods paper concerns other maps. Public archive near matches—Signum neutral continuum, fourth-root Polar Express \(n^{-1/4}\), SAM sign perturbation—are not equivalent. The searches found no stronger source logically implying the exact all-\(\beta\) flip boundary, unique attracting supercritical two-cycle, and cubic critical-rate coefficient. Residual independent-priority uncertainty remains and is explicitly recorded.
residual_risks: Historical priority is not certified; a generic dynamical-systems theorem for odd smooth saturating two-dimensional momentum maps may subsume this special case, though no such covering statement was identified in the actual searches.
Finite web/index coverage and accessible public source material cannot prove the absence of equivalent work elsewhere.
Higher-period attractors and global basins remain outside the claim, not an asserted uniqueness of all nonstationary dynamics.

value.rationale: The source motivated determining when analytic regularization actually suppresses nonvanishing Muon oscillations, but its guarantees are merely sufficient for small steps. The formula \(\alpha_*=2\varepsilon(1+\beta)/[a(1-\beta)]\) is an exact all-momentum hyperparameter frontier even at \(\beta\) above generic sufficient-theory ranges. The complete prime-two orbit census, exact attracting amplitude \(X\), sharp square-root onset and critical inverse-square-root slowdown give a structural classification. Unlike a renaming of a Signum computation, smoothing selects one attracting centered cycle out of the hard-sign neutral continuum. This supplies meaningful stability and oscillation-floor information for a natural new optimizer model despite being scalar and local.
